paper_title: Real-time prediction of intensive care unit patient acuity and therapy requirements using state-space modelling
prediction_task: Binary per-4h prediction of ICU patient acuity (stability/instability), mortality, and need for life-sustaining therapies (MV, VP, CRRT)

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Motivation for Mamba unclear: 4-h input windows and exclusion of long-stay patients mean APRICOT-M does not significantly outperform APRICOT-T (Transformer); advantage of SSM architecture not illustrated.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added sequence-length sensitivity analysis (Supplementary Figure S12) and inference-speed comparison (Table S16) showing Mamba advantages on longer sequences.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Bootstrap CIs reflect data-sample uncertainty but not model-parameter uncertainty; binary classification over fixed time windows creates arbitrary dichotomies that time-to-event analysis could avoid.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Explicitly acknowledged bootstrap CI and window-choice limitations in Discussion limitations section (p32, line 699).

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: CatBoost and GRU baselines appear competitive on many tasks with far lower compute cost; baseline comparison and compute discussion inadequate.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added win-rate comparisons: 61.1% vs CatBoost, 66.7% vs GRU, 69.4% vs Transformer across 36 task-dataset combinations.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Prospective validation was conducted but lacks clinical adjudication of alert timeliness, accuracy, and actionability; rare-event AUROC is overoptimistic without clinical utility assessment.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Conducted 3-clinician adjudication of prospective cases with formal SOP; added methodology, results, and discussion sections on clinical utility.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: 'Prospectively validated' terminology misleading since Mamba architecture (2023) postdates the prospective data collection period (2021-2023); clarify retrospective-on-prospective-data design.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Clarified real-time deployment architecture (Epic EHR interface, 4-h query cadence); reviewer flagged remaining terminology concern for minor revision.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: GitHub repository README lacks software/hardware requirements and dependencies; hyperparameter selection approach (systematic or ad-hoc) not documented.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Clarified Optuna-based hyperparameter tuning; reported optimal hyperparameters and search space (Supplementary Table S6).
